name: 3S Vitals
author: Joakim
description: Compact vitals HUD: stat gauges plus the current enemy and its health, now with a Settings tab. Works on both feeds: GMCP (3Scapes - Char.Vitals + Guild.State, enemy from Char.Combat, plus a Coffin gauge) and MIP (3K, or 3S with MIP on - the classic character./vik./enemy. paths). A Viking gets HP / Seid / Vig / Rad by their drift-proof named keys; every other guild gets HP / SP plus its two guild pools labelled with the server's own names for them (guild.info gp1_name/gp2_name), so any guild's bars come out right without the plugin knowing the guild. Settings pins Auto / Viking / Generic ('vitals guild ...' works too).
